parts.text: Edit this image: replace his half mask with an original FULL-FACE goalie-style hockey mask in glossy purple, covering forehead, eyes, nose, mouth and chin, with rows of small round breathing holes and a few raised violet dots as its own markings, held by black straps under the purple beanie; the eye holes are dark blackish-purple with a faint deep purple glow. Absolutely no chevrons, triangles or red markings. Keep everything else exactly the same: beanie, blue zombie skin, exposed bones, purple jumpsuit, gold chains, gold machete, gold axe on his shoulder, pixel cabin background, pose and clay style.
